card.name: Subject before a transition or leap verb
card.fires_on: Words in general web text just before a verb of making a move or change, such as 'make a transition', 'making a major investment', 'began to see'. It fires on the subject, 'a', or an adjective that comes right before that verb phrase.

modes.label: After make/making
modes.description: The word 'a' or 'make' in phrases about making a big move, investment, or comeback.
modes.example: Southern California water managers are making<< a>> major investment in desalination technology.

modes.label: Subject before a change verb
modes.description: A group noun such as a country or family, right before it starts or begins something new.
modes.example: In the second half of the 20th century many poor<< countries>> began to see rapid declines in their fertility

card.writes: It pushes toward verbs of jumping or starting out, such as jumps, embark and jump.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before text says someone makes a big move, starts something new, or takes a leap.
